'''Kashyyyk Train of Dominance''' (KTOD, with KTOD+ on the later roster) is a Star Wars CCG playtest team around [[Justin Desai]]. The 2025 spreadsheet lists KTOD and KTOD+ separately.<ref name="forum-81218">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (arebelspy), Players Committee Forums (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). Live sheet: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing Google Sheets]. Wayback: https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing. Wiki copy: [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]].</ref>

== Card credits ==
The team is credited (printed as "The KToD") with the original concept of one Players Committee [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The concept credit names where the concept was won: [[2018 Online Championship Series|Winner of the 2018 OCS]]. The card is in [[Virtual Set 13]] (released 9 November 2020).

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Card !! Set !! Released !! Credit as printed
|-
| [[Yoda, Master Of The Force (V)|•Yoda, Master Of The Force (V)]] || [[Virtual Set 13]] || 9 November 2020 || "Original concept by The KToD, Winner of the 2018 OCS"
|}

The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#KToD|KToD]] on [[Card Credits]].
